limits.per_top_expanded_bytes: unlimited; each gzip decoded view and tar member individually capped
limits.unsupported: ZIP and all other non-gzip/ustar tar encodings treated as opaque raw bytes, not expanded. Non-regular tar entries are not followed. Unknown roots/encoding schemes are not claimed clear.

qualification: Tracked paths 2001–21399 only; prefix 1–2000 retained separately. Candidate pattern hits only; stored gzip byte matches can be binary coincidences. Occurrences in distinct public member paths remain distinct, while duplicate payload scanning is cached. SHA-256 is content identity, not a claim of Git blob identity for decoded data.
